newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil in summer doldrums, premiums mixed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil in summer doldrums, premiums mixed.

text.p: European gas oil business languished in seasonal doldrums again on Thursday, producing only minimal volume at mixed premiums, traders said.

Lack of arbitrage, a high dollar and the absence on holiday of several key traders who conducted a brisk round of buying in early July has resulted in minimal demand and traded volumes even lower than last week's modest levels.
Another brake on activity has been a seasonal lull while traders plan the start of trade in winter specifications. Cargo activity, such as it is, has been mainly in diesel.
Others kept out of early trade on Thursday to avoid futures volatility ahead of the expiry of the August gasoline contract.

The only early sign of life came from the ARA barge market, where a prompt parcel of heating oil changed hands at a 50 cent premium to August IPE. A parcel of the same material for second half August was rumoured done at a 75 cent premium.
The level were slightly lower than early talk, which saw offers of up to $1.50 over August IPE for first half August.
August IPE was 50 cents firmer at $171.50 a tonne.
German heating oil cargo differentials were notionally assessed unchanged at August IPE +$1.50 for early August.
